subject: Audit log retention & KMS rotation — scope and next steps
messages:
From: ClearHealth Security <security@clearhealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended audit retention window + BYOK coordination

Hi Monica,

We're working through a procurement security checklist for our upcoming contract renewal and need clarity on two items before we can sign:

1) Audit log retention: Can Redwood provide a temporary 18-month retention window for audit logs for a scoped tenant while we complete our internal retention waiver? Our default retention is 90 days in the hosted plan; procurement is asking for an exception path.

2) KMS rotation: We run key-rotation on our HSM every 90 days. We need to understand the impact on in-flight requests and archived audit blobs when a customer-managed key is rotated. Do you have a documented sequence and rollback guidance?

Attached is a short PDF with the procurement wording and a sample retention clause. Please let us know the earliest you can share the expected time to implement and any operational limitations.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Security Ops, ClearHealth
security@clearhealth.com

Attachments: clearhealth-sla-request.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: ClearHealth Security <security@clearhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended audit retention window + BYOK coordination

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the PDF. Looping in Grace (Product), Ben (Customer Success), and Priyom (Platform) to scope impact and propose a plan.

Short answer up front: we can do a scoped 18-month retention for a single tenant as an exception route, but it requires:
- temporary modification to the audit log retention policy for that tenant (backend config + billing flag)
- explicit storage escrow for the longer window to satisfy operational SLOs
- a KMS handoff checklist for rotation events (Priyom, can you confirm what we need on infra side)

We'll follow up with a concrete action plan and timeline by Monday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended audit retention window + BYOK coordination

Quick internal notes before we respond to ClearHealth:

- Product impact: enabling 18-month retention will change storage tiering assumptions and increase costs. We need an estimate of token/log volume for the tenant to size and propose a cost pass-through or one-time surcharge.
- Feature gating: backend currently supports per-tenant retention via a config flag but it's not exposed in the console; engineering rollout is a small change but requires a migration job for historical logs.
- Audit samples: sending sample export (redwood-audit-log-sample.csv) to show schema differences; ask ClearHealth for expected query patterns.

Action items for the team:
1) Priyom: provide a short runbook for KMS rotation effects on archived logs and any required consumer-side steps (rotation window, rewrap operations). Also confirm whether we need an Ops maintenance window for key rewraps.
2) Ben: coordinate with ClearHealth procurement about cost model (monthly vs one-time).
3) Monica: approve wording for the exception and send the proposed plan to Alex with timeline.

I'll draft the product note for the internal migration steps.

—Grace
Product Manager, Security Features
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended audit retention window + BYOK coordination

Summary of infra constraints and recommended approach:

- KMS rotation and archived audit blobs: when a customer-managed key is rotated, we perform a rewrap step for stored artifacts. For large retention windows this can cause a short-lived CPU spike and IO on the archival bucket; we run a background rewrap job that is rate-limited. No data loss expected if the rotation is done per our API, but the rewrap can take hours per GB depending on key wrapping algorithms.
- For the exception: recommend a staged approach:
  a) Short pilot: enable 18-month retention on a non-prod tenant to validate migration job speed and rewrap throughput.
  b) Production enable: schedule a rolling migration during a low-traffic window; provide ClearHealth with expected maintenance window and monitoring links.
- Rollback: we don't currently have an automated rollback for rewrap once completed; rollback would require re-encrypting with prior key if available and restoring from pre-migration backup — plan for snapshotting before migration.

I'll attach a diagram (kms-rotation-diagram.png) and a short runbook to the shared Drive. If procurement needs a hard SLA on completion time for rewrap, we should price for dedicated Ops time.

—Priyom
Principal Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended audit retention window + BYOK coordination

Hi Alex / procurement team — thanks for the patience. Below is our proposed plan and next steps. Please confirm acceptance or call out any hard constraints.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Pilot & validation (2 weeks): enable 18-month retention on a sandbox tenant to run the migration and rewrap job. This validates throughput and lock windows. No cost impact to production.
2) Production enable (1 maintenance window): schedule a 4–6 hour rolling maintenance window for the tenant. Priyom's team will run the rate-limited rewrap; we will snapshot pre-migration.
3) Pricing: since this is an exception outside our hosted defaults, we propose a one-time migration fee (covers Ops time + storage delta for the extra retention months) plus a 20% storage surcharge for the extended window. Ben will share pricing options in a separate thread.
4) KMS rotation guidance: we recommend ClearHealth follow rotation via our API (we provide rewrap job triggers). Rotating keys during the migration window is not advised. If you require a stricter SLA for rewrap completion, we can provide a paid dedicated rewrap run.

Deliverables by Monday EOD (internal):
- Migration checklist and timeline (Grace)
- Pilot runbook and monitoring dashboard link (Priyom)
- Customer pricing sheet and contract language (Ben)

Next steps for ClearHealth:
- Confirm whether procurement accepts the one-time fee model and the maintenance window constraints.
- Provide an estimate of average monthly audit log volume (GB) so we can firm up storage estimates.

Links: pilot docs and runbook https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleDocLink

Attachments sent: redwood-audit-log-sample.csv (schema), kms-rotation-diagram.png (infra flow)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if you prefer.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
